test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'CHOICE' is written as '53', 'CHARGE' is written as '52', how will 'CHANCE' be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:
The sum of all alphabets +10 is equal to the code.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aebe377505ba93abb3de14a3183989be2554bd53a48aa849047cc2f286c3d51.png] 43 + 10 = 53 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15643911937cc130e99faf0414dc313c3187d12e403a3487b157df93102e61eb.png] 42 + 10 = 52

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c2d89e515d296280590321d4f2f3925418ca0b6e3b633df4818630f38351eb5.png] 34 + 10 = 44

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
